decisions.reason: As a newly launched door lever handle family in the firm's core category, it likely stays because German architectural hardware suppliers usually maintain such ranges for specification continuity and project planning reliability.
The mitred door lever handle family fits the firm's design-led portfolio and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon unless demand is clearly weak, which the website evidence does not suggest.
Although a multifunctional door lever handle is somewhat more specialized, it supports the firm's accessibility and system-solution positioning, so management would more likely keep than drop it.
Another new door lever handle line is close to the firm's established business and would typically be retained to build market presence across architects, installers and stockists.
This door and window handle collection has its own product page and an award-winning model, making it highly likely to remain on the market as a flagship design family.
A new finish can be rationalized more easily than a full hardware family, but this patinated bronze option matches the firm's architecture-focused premium offering and is still likely to be kept.
